evidence: The Fear and Greed Index reads 11, indicating Extreme Fear, with a 7-day average of 14.86 following multiple consecutive days near cyclical lows (10-13). While prolonged extreme sentiment reflects heavy selling pressure and risk-off market conditions, persistent single-digit and low-teens readings historically exhibit oversold characteristics that marginally favor short-term mean-reversion relief bounces over a 24-hour window rather than immediate sustained continuation down.
limitations: Sentiment index updates once daily and lags real-time spot price action
Extreme fear can persist during sustained macro sell-offs
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
